conf.description: zos-smf job-accounting, format other: hand-built SMF30 KVP-delimited parse, subtype-to-verb mapping with dead-letter-by-drop for unknown subtypes, date+time combination, termination-flag array, before batched rename.

conf.comment: zos-smf/job-accounting/other. Site formatter output assumed KVP (key=value tokens) using the literal SMF30* mapping-macro names, consistent with this technology's dataset-access/tcpip precedent -- real column grammar not confirmed against a sample. SMF30DTE/SMF30TME are assumed already rendered as parseable date/time text by the formatter (not raw packed julian/hundredths), same assumption this technology's other pipelines make; no LPAR-UTC-offset table exists anywhere in this work order, so _time is naive local time, undercorrected (documented gap, same category as the sibling pipelines). SMF30SCC's accompanying abend-flag halfword is not decoded -- no bit-layout is given -- so process.exit_code is the raw completion code only; abend flavour is NOT derived from it. process.command_line is permanently absent per the dataset description (SMF30 has no PARM string), not a collection gap.

functions.description: extract SMF30* key=value tokens from the formatter's delimited output

dead-letter approximation: discard records whose SMF30STP subtype is not one of the five documented values, rather than landing with an empty event.action (no Route-level dead-letter destination is in scope here, so this pipeline drops instead)

compute event.action from the subtype, combine SMF30DTE+SMF30TME into _time, copy the raw completion code, and split the termination-indicator enum into an array -- all from ORIGINAL vendor names before rename
batch rename every straightforward mapped/custom SMF30 field, clean source identifiers, no transform needed
tag event.dataset (no hyphen) and drop the raw subtype/packed-time/completion/termination keys fully consumed above, plus _raw
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
